title: Git WAL immutable envelope v1
description: Immutable Git WAL envelope for Publication, Refs, RepositoryConfig, Remote, Worktree, ScopedCommit, Sync and Land. Sync records its prepared index state and a one-shot commit-attempt barrier before moving the checkout ref. RemoteFetch/RemotePush share explicit per-target old/new tips across Publication and non-event transfers. SHA-256 covers recursively key-sorted UTF-8 JSON with digest omitted. Semantic transitions, namespace grants, object-format checks and live authority remain Rust obligations; evidence never grants effect authority. Worktree records bind canonical paths, the exact registration identity, tip and consumer delivery digest; interrupted effects are never repeated. Land freezes the candidate and opaque consumer evidence before its one-shot target attempt; business settlement remains consumer-owned. SafeRestore binds its retained durable snapshot before the one-shot reset; restore-applied binds exact post-effect bytes for observe-only recovery.
